# Codys Colours

Codys Colours is a free Mac colour workflow panel for Adobe Illustrator and
Adobe Photoshop by Cody Harker.

Official website:
https://thepianoboi-cmyk.github.io/Codys-Colours/

Official repository:
https://github.com/thepianoboi-cmyk/Codys-Colours

Latest release:
https://github.com/thepianoboi-cmyk/Codys-Colours/releases/latest

Summary:
Codys Colours helps designers search, pick, compare, convert, extract,
favourite, palette, and apply colours inside Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop.
The public build is free and includes generic starter colours only. Users can
import CSV or JSON colour libraries that they are authorised to use.

Licence summary:
Free personal and commercial use is allowed. Resale, rebranding,
white-labelling, mirroring, or standalone redistribution is not allowed without
written permission from Cody Harker. Commercial public use must keep visible
credit to Codys Colours by Cody Harker.
